title: hylotelephium telephioides
intro: Hylotelephium telephioides, commonly known as Korean Sedum or Telephium, is a species of succulent plant in the family Crassulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Korea, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hylotelephium telephioides include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These constituents have been shown to possess antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities, which may contribute to the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
